definition.zh-TW: 行銷費用占營業收入的比例，看公司為了做生意要花多少在廣告與促銷上。數值越高表示越依賴行銷。
definition.en: Marketing expense as a share of revenue: how much has to be spent on advertising and promotion to win the business. Higher means a heavier reliance on marketing.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
